title: My Neighborhood
text:
I live in a small neighborhood in the city. There is a park near my house. Many children play there after school. There is also a small shop on the corner.

My neighbor is Anna. She has a big dog named Max. Every morning she walks with him in the park. I like my neighborhood because it is quiet and friendly.

questions.text: What is the name of the neighbor's dog?
Why does the writer like the neighborhood?
options: It is very big and noisy
It is far from the city

questions.text: What can we guess about the neighbor?
options: She often goes to the park

vocabulary.definition: an area where people live near each other
kind and pleasant to be with
the place where two streets meet

paragraph_translations: Mieszkam w małej okolicy w mieście. W pobliżu mojego domu jest park. Wielu dzieci tam bawi się po szkole. Na rogu jest też mały sklep.
Moja sąsiadka to Anna. Ma dużego psa o imieniu Max. Każdego ranka spaceruje z nim po parku. Lubię swoją okolicę, bo jest cicha i przyjazna.
